author: qwen3-coder-next
brief: Phase: bug fix. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Node.js 24 library and small CLI (no dependencies) that pages through a large in-memory product catalogue for an export job (a pager, a sorter, filters, a CSV writer, tests, CI config, docs; about 25 files). Build a task where the owner reports symptoms (some products appear twice in an export, a few never appear, the last page is sometimes empty, the count in the summary is wrong when a filter is set), with no diagnosis. The code holds two or three interacting defects, one subtle (for example an unstable sort on equal keys combined with an off-by-one page boundary). Visible tests pass today and do not point at the defects.
